geometry.note: Frames and stations of the slice contract, bound by hash. The twin record supplies the axis convention only; no geometry is consumed.

implementation.hash_method: sha256 of the file bytes with CRLF normalised to LF

label: SYNTHETIC REPLAY: every observation was generated by software. The verdicts below describe software behaviour on a synthetic fixture and say nothing about any Porsche 993.
limitations: Offline replay of one immutable observation set; no live cadence, latency or availability is shown.
Parameters are synthetic placeholders; no prediction is a Porsche value.
Frame verdicts share the parameter uncertainty and are not independent trials.
A digitally_checked status means the declared rules executed; it is not physical correlation.

residual_rules.residual_definition: r = observed - predicted, both in the canonical unit and, for N_FAN, expressed about +Z of F_FAN.
residual_rules.systematic_note: Parameter uncertainty is shared by every frame, so frame verdicts are correlated and their counts are not independent trials.
residual_rules.uncertainty_definition: u_r = sqrt(u_predicted^2 + u_observed^2), standard uncertainties (k = 1). u_predicted propagates input and parameter uncertainties to first order; z = r / u_r.
